briefings.title: FULL: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent testifies on the Iran war, gas prices and inflation

people.name: Maxine Waters
people.role: Ranking Member, House Financial Services Committee

briefings.tldr: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent defended the administration's economic record, highlighting strong 4Q GDP projections (surpassing 4%), the "greatest economic isolation campaign in history" against Iran, and $325 billion in tax refunds, while facing tough questioning from committee members over high Treasury yields, inflation, and volatile tech and trade policies.
